breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions in the original prompt (both Dirichlet and Periodic were specified). It resolved this by removing the incorrect 'Periodic' condition and only including the 'Dirichlet boundary conditions u = 0 on all boundaries', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
